videos.title: Big changes are coming to Instagram
videos.description:
If you’re under 18, the Instagram you know is about to change. Time limits, nighttime blocks, and reminders every 15 minutes are among the sweeping changes Meta pledged to make to its teen accounts as part of its major lawsuit settlement today. Do you think they’ll be enough to protect teen mental health?

videos.title: Does smart home tech work in a college dorm? | The Vergecast
videos.description:
It can be hard enough to set up smart home tech in a house or an apartment, but what about a dorm room? Jennifer Pattison Tuohy recently tested out some smart home tech when she dropped off her son for his freshman year at Clemson. Jen reports back to David Imel on how the gadgets stood up to the challenges of college Wi-Fi and rules against hanging things on the wall.
